acceptance.draftNotice: This item is in draft, so its criteria can still be corrected. The criterion key is permanent identity and is never reassigned.
acceptance.lockedNotice: This item has left draft, so criteria can no longer be edited — only evaluated. The criterion key is permanent identity.

apply.planning: Planning the change. Nothing is written in this step.
apply.keyHelp: Generated once for this intention and reused on every retry. Keep it: if the network drops mid-apply, retrying with this exact key is what stops one change becoming two.
apply.replayedBody: The engine recognised this idempotency key and replayed the original result. Nothing was written a second time.

failure.conflict-idempotency: This key was already used for a different change
failure.plan-changed: The plan is no longer current

apply.conflictVersionBody: The item moved between reading it and applying this change, so the change was refused rather than applied on top. Re-read it and compare before deciding — re-sending would overwrite whatever the other change did.
apply.versionRequiredBody: This command requires the item's current version and none was sent. Re-open the item so its version tag is read again.
apply.conflictIdempotencyBody: This idempotency key was already used with a different body, version or plan. The engine refused rather than guess which one you meant. Start the change again to get a new key.
apply.conflictDomainBody: The kernel's own rules refused this command — for example an illegal transition or a dependency cycle. Re-reading will not change the answer; the command has to change.
apply.otherBody: The change did not go through.
apply.inputIntro: The engine requires these before the change can be planned. Without them it refuses the command outright.
apply.planChangedBody: The plan changed between showing it and applying it, so nothing was written. Re-open the action to plan again and read the new one before confirming.

code.label: Code
code.hint: A short machine token: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Free text, recorded with the change. This is what another session will read.

evidence_ref.label: Evidence reference
evidence_ref.hint: Where the evidence for this verdict lives. Required to record passed or failed.

evidence_hash.label: Evidence hash
evidence_hash.hint: A sha256 digest of that evidence. Required to record passed.

waiver_decision_id.label: Waiver decision
waiver_decision_id.hint: The decision that authorises waiving this criterion, if there is one.

holder_sid.label: Holder session
holder_sid.hint: The canonical session id that will hold the lease. The engine refuses anything that is not one.

fence.label: Fence
fence.hint: The lease fence you are acting on. The engine refuses anything below 1, and a stale one loses to the current holder.

decision_id.label: Decision
decision_id.hint: The decision this act rests on. Rebasing a clock is evidence-bearing: the engine will not take it unnamed.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.subtitle: The append-only decision record and its current-state projection.
decisions.historyNotice: This is the append-only history. The engine does not attribute current state to these rows, so none of them is labelled in force or revoked — switch to one of the other views to ask that question.

state.notAttributed: State not attributed in this view

decisions.revokeBody: Revoking is recorded as a new entry; the original decision is never deleted.

effective.title: No decisions in force
effective.body: The engine read the current-state projection and found none in force.

revoked.title: No revoked decisions
revoked.body: The engine read the current-state projection and found none revoked.

history.title: No decisions recorded
history.body: Nothing has been decided here yet.

events.none: No events recorded for this item.

items.title: Work items
items.subtitle: Filters narrow the whole store, not just the page you are looking at.

empty.title: No work items match
empty.body: Nothing in the store matches these filters. This is a real, complete answer — the engine read the store and found none.

lease.noWrite: Your role cannot change this lease.
lease.noAdmin: Taking over, revoking and rebasing need lease admin.
lease.noRead: Your role cannot read this lease.

stream.unavailableBody: The list on screen may be out of date, and nothing else will tell you so. Refresh to read the store directly.

subtitle: The durable cross-session backlog: work items, ownership, dependencies, acceptance criteria and decisions. Every change is planned before it is applied.
title: Work

truncation.label: Loaded {{n}} rows; there are more
truncation.hint: This list is paged by keyset and the engine caps a page at 200. Only the loaded rows are shown; use the filters to narrow it.

unavailable.title: Could not look
unavailable.body: The engine could not complete this observation, so it is reporting an unknown outcome rather than a result. Treat nothing on this panel as confirmed.
unavailable.retryHint: Whether the change was written is undetermined. Retry with the SAME idempotency key — that is what makes the retry safe, because the engine will recognise it as the same intention rather than a second one.

LIMPIO.label: Clean
LIMPIO.help: The engine looked and found nothing wrong.

ROTO.label: Broken
ROTO.help: The engine looked and found a rule violation.

NO_HE_PODIDO_MIRAR.label: Could not look
NO_HE_PODIDO_MIRAR.help: The engine could NOT complete the observation. This is not a pass and not an empty result — the answer is unknown.
